lines: The app is published again, from the build that has the first pictures, after a clean build, the first picture check and a fresh security review that found nothing blocking. Summer's seven owners are an hour and a half into the last fix pass before summer's last round. The change of season has a new head that loses nothing to black, but its glow is a column and summer arrives blue, so it gets one more turn. A correction to Status 168: 3 of 15 viewers took summer for a frame from a top-budget film or game cinematic and none took it for a photograph.
Next: the owners' mid-pass pictures at about 18:15, their reports at 19:20, my own look at the merged picture, then Round 22, summer's last.

allowance (after the review): 15.16 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The change from spring to summer, three frames at its peak. Top row: main, where the table and the base go black. Bottom row: the builder's new head, which keeps tone and lights the new base but floods as a column and a flat oval.
The seeds at rest, the approved on the left and ours mid-pass on the right: the heads are round wheels of down now; the stalks still read as sticks and the lights are a half stop short.
The landing mid-pass: one whirl of long thin arcs, nothing green flying, the tree dark and clean; the lanterns do not bloom through it yet.
Four frames of the same change at final tier on the builder's head: no black anywhere, and summer arriving sky blue in the last frame, where the approved storm is cream gold.
